# ECO-ROD LTD

> ECO-ROD LTD is a drainage company based in Nottingham, England. We provide 24/7 drain unblocking, toilet unblocking, drain cleaning, high pressure jetting, CCTV drain inspections, drain repair and installation, and drain rodent trap installation for homes and businesses across Nottingham, Derby, Leicester and Lincoln, and the towns around them.

## Services

- [Drain Unblocking](https://www.eco-rodltd.com/services/drain-unblocking): Blocked sinks, baths, toilets and outside drains cleared with drain rods or high pressure jetting, day or night.
- [Toilet Unblocking](https://www.eco-rodltd.com/services/toilet-unblocking): Blocked and overflowing toilets cleared for homes and businesses, 24/7.
- [Drain Cleaning](https://www.eco-rodltd.com/services/drain-cleaning): Grease, silt and scale cleaned out of drains, including regular maintenance for commercial kitchens.
- [High Pressure Jetting](https://www.eco-rodltd.com/services/high-pressure-jetting): Water jetting for stubborn and recurring blockages and heavy build up.
- [CCTV Drain Inspection](https://www.eco-rodltd.com/services/cctv-drain-inspection): Camera surveys that find cracks, root ingress, collapses and blockages, with a written report and recommendations.
- [Drain Repair & Installation](https://www.eco-rodltd.com/services/drain-repair-and-installation-services): Damaged drains repaired or replaced, and new drains and connections installed.
- [Drain Rodent Trap Installation](https://www.eco-rodltd.com/services/drain-rodent-trap-installation): Rat blockers fitted inside drains to stop rats coming up from the sewer.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do you offer 24/7 emergency drainage services?**
Yes. We are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including evenings and weekends.

**Do you work with businesses?**
Yes. We work with homeowners, tenants, landlords and letting agents, restaurants and takeaways, shops, offices and housing providers. Clients include Burger King, KFC and Nottinghamshire Fire & Rescue Service. We offer one-off call-outs and regular drain maintenance.

**Who is responsible for a blocked drain?**
Generally, the property owner is responsible for drains that only serve their property and sit within its boundary. Shared sewers and pipes beyond the boundary are usually the water company's responsibility: Severn Trent in Nottingham, Derby and Leicester, and Anglian Water in Lincoln.

**How can I book?**
Call 0115 837 1711 (24/7), message us on WhatsApp at +44 7366 299 741, email info@eco-rodltd.com, or use the contact form at https://www.eco-rodltd.com/#contact.
